files_changed.summary: Guard: open no live channel without a session/profile (g1).
Ids from the shared context, leader from the members meta, presence from usePresence (g2).
The rail: peer count + leader indicator (g2).
3 tests: leader resolution, peers/flag, empty ids.
Mount the rail in the toolbar (g3).
Mock the presence rail (it reads the context this unit test does not provide).

decisions: usePresence is inert without a session/profile: subscribing to `live:` with an empty id would be wrong, and the context can be empty on first paint.
The leader's id comes from the members meta (the roster's own home); features/presence reads the two fields it needs because it may not import features/workspace's MemberMeta type (I3).
The rail mounts app-level (I4-safe) and consumes the shared context; it adds no feature coupling.
Peer-cursor canvas painting and cursor publishing are deliberately out of scope: they need the page's displayed size/rotation and a pointer stream, and are a separate task (recorded).
